title: Run Seedance 2.5 on your original footage (e.g., via Lovart) to generate…
content: Run Seedance 2.5 on your original footage (e.g., via Lovart) to generate alternate camera angles—close-up, wide, low, overhead—from a single take without reshooting.
tips: Run Seedance 2.5 on your original footage (e.g., via Lovart) to generate alternate camera angles—close-up, wide, low, overhead—from a single take without reshooting.

es.content: Ejecuta Seedance 2.5 sobre tu metraje original (por ejemplo, a través de Lovart) para generar ángulos de cámara alternativos —primer plano, plano general, ángulo bajo, cenital— a partir de una sola toma, sin necesidad de volver a grabar.

fr.content: Exécutez Seedance 2.5 sur vos images d’origine (par exemple via Lovart) pour générer des angles de caméra alternatifs — gros plan, plan large, contre-plongée, vue plongeante — à partir d’une seule prise, sans refaire le tournage.

ja.content: 元の映像素材（例：Lovart経由）に Seedance 2.5 を適用して、再撮影なしで1テイクからクローズアップ、ワイド、ローアングル、俯瞰などの別カメラアングルを生成できます。

ko.content: 원본 영상(예: Lovart를 통해)에 Seedance 2.5를 적용해, 재촬영 없이 한 번의 촬영본에서 클로즈업, 와이드, 로우 앵글, 오버헤드 등 다양한 대체 카메라 앵글을 생성하세요.

pt.content: Execute o Seedance 2.5 em suas imagens originais (por exemplo, via Lovart) para gerar ângulos de câmera alternativos — close-up, wide, low, overhead — a partir de uma única tomada, sem precisar refilmar.

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2.5 处理你的原始素材（例如通过 Lovart），即可从单次拍摄中生成不同的机位角度——特写、广角、低机位、俯拍——无需重新拍摄。
